verdict.rationale: ROS 2's QoS policies are explicitly designed to handle non-ideal/degraded networks (ros2-docs-3, ros2-docs-14, ros2-docs-22, ros2-docs-41), and rosbag tooling lets nodes record/buffer data locally (ros2-docs-17, ros2-docs-23, ros2-docs-39), which supports continued local operation and data capture. However, ROS 2 itself has no built-in cloud-connectivity or cloud-sync/reconnection-recovery mechanism documented — that would be a separate bridge/cloud-connector component, not core ROS 2. Missing for 10: explicit cloud-dropout detection, automatic reconnection/resync-to-cloud behavior, and any documented 'store-and-forward to cloud' pattern.
